bibl.title: Iudicium Dei XVI: iron ordeal ritual

listBibl.bibl: Felix Liebermann, Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, vol. 1 (Halle: Niemeyer, 1903), p. 429

An English crib of the Latin text, semi-literal, made for this database in 2026 with Claude, a large language model (LLM) made by Anthropic. It keeps close to the wording of the original and uses the established English of Anglo-Latin legal, liturgical and canon-law formulae. It is an aid to reading the original, not a published translation. Square brackets mark Liebermann’s additions to the text or, now and then, words supplied for the sense; “[?]” marks a doubtful reading

div.head: Iud Dei XVI 32
div.ab: Post psalmos dicat hanc orationem: Adiutorium nostrum in nomine Domini. Sit nomen Domini b[enedictum].
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 429 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: After the psalms let him say this prayer: Our help is in the name of the Lord. May the name of the Lord be b[lessed].
